        WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY

        Motorsport Tickets is an official reseller to the world's premier motorsport circuits. This means we offer the broadest selection of ticket options for all races across the F1 calendar. From general admission and grandstand tickets, to hospitality and paddock club options. Tickets for 2026 races are now available, and we recommend booking as far in advance as possible to ensure you get your desired ticket type.

          NOW IS A GREAT TIME TO GO TO F1

          The 2026 Formula 1 season arrives with a rare sense of stability across the grid, following one of the most compelling championship battles in recent history. After Lando Norris secured his first World Championship title in 2025, the spotlight now turns to whether McLaren can build on that success as rivals regroup with continuity rather than wholesale change.

          Unlike recent seasons, the majority of teams head into 2026 with unchanged driver line-ups. McLaren retain their proven pairing of Norris and Oscar Piastri, while Ferrari continue with Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc as Hamilton enters another year in pursuit of a record-breaking eighth title. Mercedes also opt for consistency, backing George Russell alongside Kimi Antonelli as their long-term vision takes shape.

          Across the grid, familiar partnerships remain intact, underlining a collective focus on maximising performance as Formula 1 enters a new technical era. Aston Martin, Williams, Haas, Alpine and Audi (formerly Sauber) have all opted for stability, while Isack Hadjar steps into Yuki Tsunoda’s former seat to partner Max Verstappen at Red Bull. The only rookie on the grid in 2026 is Arvid Lindblad, with the Red Bull Junior Driver joining their sister team, Racing Bulls.

          One major talking point for 2026 is the arrival of Cadillac, Formula 1’s newest team. The American manufacturer’s entry expands the grid and adds fresh intrigue to the championship, marking a significant moment for the sport’s global growth and its presence in North America. While expectations will be measured in their debut season, Cadillac’s long-term ambitions bring an exciting new dynamic to the paddock.

          With fewer driver changes to dominate headlines, attention shifts firmly to the on-track battle. Can Norris defend his crown against a hungry field? Will Red Bull reassert their dominance, or can Ferrari and Mercedes mount sustained title challenges? With margins tighter than ever, 2026 promises high-stakes racing from the very first lights-out.

          The Formula 1 calendar for 2026 remains largely unchanged, featuring a globe-spanning schedule of iconic circuits and fan-favourite venues. Australia once again opens the season, with Abu Dhabi playing host to the finale once again

          Sprint Races will take place in China, Miami, Canada, Silverstone, Zandvoort and Singapore, ensuring fans attending those Grands Prix enjoy competitive action on all three days of the race weekend. Combined with a full support programme featuring Formula 2, Formula 3 and the Porsche Supercup, spectators can expect wall-to-wall racing throughout the season.

          Tickets for the 2026 Formula 1 season are on sale and selling fast, so start planning your next motorsport adventure today!

            WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

            Three days of action

            A Formula 1 weekend comprises of two days of scintillating practice and qualifying sessions, building up to Sunday’s main event: the Grand Prix. And in 2025, there will be even more action on track with six events hosting Sprint qualifying races on Saturday afternoon meaning more action for fans at the circuit.

            Ticket types

            There are many different ways for fans to experience a Grand Prix weekend suiting all budgets and styles. From roaming general admission tickets, allowing spectators to wander different vantage points, to grandstand tickets that place fans in the best position for catch action and overtakes, as well as premium hospitality and Paddock Club tickets.

            Other activities

            There are numerous opportunities throughout the weekend to see the drivers and teams out of the cars. Before Sunday’s race, drivers will take to the circuit for the traditional parade lap of the circuit, while appearances and interviews will be accessible to fans across the event.

            WHY BOOK WITH MOTORSPORT TICKETS?

            Choice

            Motorsport Tickets has all Formula 1, MotoGP, and World Endurance Championship, as well as the iconic Le Man 24 hours and Isle of Man TT and an ever-growing selection of new racing events and unique motorsport experiences for you to enjoy!

            Value

            Convenience

            Motorsport Tickets is a one-stop destination where you can also acquire accommodation, travel and hospitality elements in addition to your ticket booking.

            Service

            Our first-class customer service team are available by email and live chat to answer any queries before or after your purchase and during your experience to ensure that it is unforgettable.

            Personal

            You can contact us directly for expert advice and to discuss tailor-made packages to accommodate all your needs.
